messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: release v1.9.3 -> canary @ 2024-06-06T22:00Z. Starting in eu-west1. build: sha:abc123. /cc @eve @carla
eve: Hold that deploy — we're seeing a DB failover incident in prod. oncall?
oncall: Oncall here, investigating. Incident INC-2024-042: master DB failover triggered, increased 503s. Triage: impact on write-heavy endpoints. https://pagerduty/INC-2024-042
ryan: Recommend gating deploy until DB stable. 5xx spiked to ~12% in last 2m. Rolling changes now would add churn.
carla: Agree. Freezing all releases. Eve, can you pin the canary to previous version? I can stop the deploy job.
eve: Pinning release to v1.9.2 and aborting canary. Release notes will note: "rollback: revert db-migration-optim (failed)"
deploy-bot: Action taken: canary abort requested by eve. Stopping rollout. Job 7890 canceled. :warning:
maria: Product note: hold public release notes until we confirm stability. We'll add a short blurb in next changelog.
ryan: Plan: 1) revert recent schema-related PR 4112 on prod 2) monitor 10m 3) resume canary if 503s < 1% over 10m.
carla: Running the revert now: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-server --to-revision=3`
oncall: Revert started. ETA ~3m. I'll update once checks pass.
ryan: If revert doesn't stabilize, prepare a staged rollback across regions with rate-limiting. Avoid full flip unless necessary.
eve: Scheduling update: change window moved to 2024-06-07T02:00Z to allow extra monitoring. I've updated the release calendar.
deploy-bot: Release calendar updated by eve. New window: 2024-06-07T02:00Z. Pin: v1.9.2. Job will re-run only on manual resume. :white_check_mark:
oncall: Revert complete. 503s down to 0.8% over last 5m. Monitoring continues.
ryan: :thumbsup: Good. Keep the hold for 30m. Eve — please draft a short rollback note for release docs.
eve: Drafting note: "Postponed canary due to DB failover; pinned to previous stable version. Follow-up incident report forthcoming." Sending for review.
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll brief support and CS. We'll wait for the incident postmortem before requeueing deploy.
carla: Disabling scheduled auto-rollouts for the day: `deploybot disable-schedule --team eng-releases`
deploy-bot: Confirm: auto-rollouts disabled by carla. :lock:
oncall: Closing thread for now; will reopen if metrics shift.
